title: Equivariant persistence topological complexity
summary: We introduce equivariant persistent analogues of Lusternik-Schnirelmann category, topological complexity, cup length, and zero-divisors cup length for persistent spaces with group actions, and establish their stability. In particular, we investigate their behavior under equivariant interleavings and obtain bounds for the corresponding erosion distances.
